Overall verdict: needs_changes. The implementer’s audit declared `Repo: DontPanic`, `Env: dev`, `Project: (none)` correctly, and their recorded commands contain no forbidden command shapes.

FINDING (high, correctness): Fleet dashboard builds can render an empty Settings inventory on the default All Projects selection. Evidence: `_build_main` mirrors project/fleet state for `--project all|<name>` but does not write a top-level `state/config-inventory.json` on the project/fleet build path (`scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/dashboard.py:1492`); the dashboard defaults selection to `all` (`dashboard/lib/project-selector-logic.js:130`), and `resolveConfigInventory()` returns only the top-level inventory for `all` (`dashboard/lib/config-inventory-logic.js:91`), so `renderConfigInventoryHTML(null)` shows the empty state. Recommendation: for `dashboard build --project all`, write a top-level machine/fleet inventory or make All Projects aggregate/render per-project inventories, and add a regression test for the default All Projects Settings render.
